title: XOR cancellation
explanation: XOR is order-independent, so pair up the 5s first: (5 ^ 5) ^ 3 = 0 ^ 3 = 3. This cancellation is the entire trick behind Single Number and Missing Number.

title: Drill: count set bits
prompt: From memory: return the number of 1-bits in `n` (n ≥ 0) using the `x & (x - 1)` clear-lowest-bit loop — not Integer.bitCount.

solution.explanation: `n - 1` turns the lowest 1 into 0 and the zeros below it into 1s, so `n & (n - 1)` erases exactly that bit. The loop runs once per set bit: O(popcount) ≤ 32 steps, O(1) space.

hints: Is there a way to remove exactly one set bit per step, instead of looking at all 32 positions?
Subtracting 1 flips the lowest set bit and every bit below it. AND that with the original.

title: Drill: power of two?
prompt: From memory (clear-lowest-bit trick): return whether `n` is a power of two. A positive power of two has exactly one set bit, so `n & (n - 1)` clears it to 0.

solution.explanation: Powers of two have a single 1-bit, so clearing the lowest set bit leaves 0. Zero has no set bits and negatives have the sign bit, so the `n > 0` guard is required. O(1) time and space.

hints: What does a power of two look like in binary?
Exactly one set bit. Which trick removes one set bit?
`n > 0 && (n & (n - 1)) == 0`. The `n > 0` guard rules out 0 and negatives.

title: >> on a negative
options: Infinite loop: `>>` copies the sign bit in, so n gets stuck at -1 and never reaches 0
explanation: `>>` is an arithmetic shift: a negative number keeps filling with 1s from the left and ends at `-1` (all 1s), and `-1 >> 1 == -1`. Use `n >>>= 1` (zero-fill), loop exactly 32 times, or use `n &= (n - 1)`.

title: Recall: the bit identities
prompt: Fill in the core bit tricks: clear the lowest set bit, the counting-bits DP, and adding without `+`.
explanation: `n & (n - 1)` drops the lowest 1-bit. `i >> 1` is i without its lowest bit, which was already computed, so add back `i & 1`. For addition, `a & b` marks the columns that carry (shift them left), and `a ^ b` is the sum without carries. Repeat until there are no carries.
